customer_name: Agricultural Bank of China (中国农业银行)
business_problem: Agricultural Bank of China needed to accelerate its smart-banking transformation and automate document-heavy service flows, because manual data entry, account opening, and report processing were slow, costly, and hard to scale across retail, agriculture, and lending scenarios.
solution_summary: Baidu AI Cloud and Agricultural Bank of China built the ABC Financial Brain and then extended it with an OCR Intelligent Service Cloud that strengthened the platform's perception engine. The OCR service cloud provides six recognition capabilities — general OCR, ID-card OCR, bank-card OCR, form OCR, business-license OCR, and custom-template OCR — on top of a loose-coupled distributed architecture with high availability, dynamic horizontal scaling, application-level rate limiting, and millisecond-class real-time service. This lets the bank embed OCR and related AI abilities into scenarios such as farmer registration for Agricultural Bank e-Manager, smart credit processing, smart mobile banking, and centralized operations optimization. The broader financial-brain stack combines AI, big data, cloud computing, IoT, and blockchain into a unified intelligent-banking service platform, while a joint innovation lab and staged production rollouts helped the bank move from concept to enterprise deployment within a short period.

solution_components.name: ABC Financial Brain
solution_components.role: Provides the bank's broader intelligent-banking platform and supplies the perception and thinking engines used across many business scenarios.

solution_components.name: OCR Intelligent Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Handles document and identity recognition tasks across account opening, lending, mobile banking, and operations workflows at large scale.

data_flow: Customer IDs, bank cards, forms, licenses, and other documents are captured by OCR Intelligent Service Cloud, parsed into structured fields through the Financial Brain's perception layer, and passed into account opening, lending, mobile banking, and operations workflows that feed the bank's wider intelligent-service platform.
business_outcome: ABC reduced manual processing effort, improved document-recognition quality, accelerated smart-banking rollout, and created a reusable intelligent-service layer for many banking scenarios.
architecture_clues: The OCR service cloud is built on a loose-coupled distributed architecture with high availability and dynamic horizontal scaling.
The Financial Brain is explicitly split into perception and thinking engines.
The rollout moved from a joint innovation lab to staged production launches over a short timeline.
evidence_quotes: ABC and Baidu built the ABC Financial Brain, taking it from idea incubation and lab verification into full production in the bank. (original: 中国农业银行与百度联手打造农行金融大脑，完成了从创意孵化、实验室验证到正式在农行生产环境投产。)

The OCR Intelligent Service Cloud includes six OCR capabilities and reaches recognition accuracy above 98%. (original: OCR智能服务云，包括六大能力：通用OCR、身份证OCR识别、银行卡OCR识别、表格OCR识别、营业执照OCR识别，还支持自定义模板OCR识别；...识别准确率达到98%以上。)

The OCR service cloud runs on a loose-coupled distributed architecture that supports high availability, dynamic horizontal scaling, application-level rate limiting, and millisecond real-time service. (original: 本次OCR智能服务云采用了金融大脑统一的松耦合分布式架构，可支持高可用和动态水平扩展...提供应用级限流，MS级实时服务等。)
The OCR service cloud is already in 13 production scenarios and incubating 20 more use cases. (original: 当前，OCR智能服务云已为农行的农银e管家、智慧信贷、智能掌银、集中作业运营优化等13大业务场景中提供多样化的智能应用...并且正在孵化20类场景。)

Within a little over one year, the platform grew to support AI services for more than 400 million individual customers and 4 million corporate customers. (original: 在短短一年多时间内，农行金融大脑已逐步“落地开花”，为农行超过4亿个人客户、400万对公客户提供AI智能服务。)
